messages:
alex: Kicking off staged canary to 8% now. Deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-08. Change window 08:00-09:00 UTC. Dash: https://dash.re/canary/deploy-2026-03-23-08 :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started 1 at 08:02 UTC. Target 8% across regions. Auto-lift disabled. Logs: https://logs.re/deploy-2026-03-23-08

mona: quick check: overall error rate up slightly at 08:05, embed p95 + small 5xx bump on long-seq requests. https://dash.re/metrics/embed

ben: digging: no pod crashes, but KV cache miss rate and evictions rose on nodes handling longer-history customers. Evictions 5/min -> 60/min coincident with shift.

tara: option: pause and narrow the canary, or graceful rollback/pin. Change window ~50m left.

alex: prefer a pause and a short stop/go call. Hold further lifts. @deploy-bot can you pause auto-lift?

deploy-bot: available actions: `pause`, `rollback --to <tag>`, `pin --version <tag>`, `reroute --selector <expr> --to-version <tag>`. Run `/deploy action <action>` to execute.

ben: vote: slice-route long-history traffic to stable v2.3.1 and keep rest on new build. We can limit impact and collect traces.

mona: vote: rollback full canary if slice-routing isn't quick to implement. Concerned about customer-facing 5xxs.

tara: vote: implement slice routing now, fallback to rollback in 10m if signals don't improve.

alex: consensus: slice route then monitor 10m. @deploy-bot apply slice reroute: selector client.history>500 -> v2.3.1

deploy-bot: reroute applied for selector "client.history>500" to v2.3.1. Monitoring for 10m. Incident INC-2026-147 created.

ben: immediate drop in 5xx for the affected slice. Overall p95 improving. Good sign.

mona: thanks. If stable after 10m, we can continue rollout. If not, rollback and pin.

tara: adding release note line: "Canary partially routed for long-history clients to v2.3.1 due to KV cache pressure; investigating tokenizer change."

alex: follow-ups: @ben to own traces and remediation, @mona to update release notes and support playbook. If we need to rollback: `/deploy rollback --to v2.3.1 --deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-08 --reason "kv-eviction spike"`

deploy-bot: noted. Will execute on command.

alex: closing this thread for now; tracking in INC-2026-147. Will reconvene if signals worsen. :white_check_mark:
